title: Do not invent the author’s experiences
rule: Do not invent experiences for the author.
example: Write “The report describes a difficult launch” when only the report is supplied.
counterexample: Write “I remember losing sleep during that launch” for an author who never supplied that experience.
rationale: The writer’s personal history must come from the writer.
evidence: Migrated from existing repository guidance: `deslopify/ne-fac/_template/models/anthropic/general.md`. Examples are illustrative.
